text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...Mock race right now!? Hauled all way 
to Oi racetrack... right in front of crowd!?

text_block_list.name: Townsfolk
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Inari-chan!! 
Chief told us, came to watch~!!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Lively bunch, eh? Ones you're racin' 
joinin' team just like you. 
Good time to throw down, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Way too out of blue! 
Well, Chief says so, I'll run...!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Good. ...Go get geared up.

"Race" Chief wanted me to see... mock race 
between Inari One and new stablemates.

Looking round, Chief called out half the town. 
Soba granny, festival shopkeeper, 
even stray boss cat...
Under high-spirited gaze of whole crowd—race began.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Mock race with new recruits... 
fine, but why no warnin'? 
Tell me day of? Hmm...)

text_block_list.name: Purple Scrunchie Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (――Can't lose focus now, gotta stay sharp! She's runnin' with everything she's got, but stamina's bound to run dry real soon, ain't it? Time to make my move……!)

text_block_list.name: Purple Scrunchie Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Uu……oOOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (!? She ain't……fallin' behind at all!?)

text_block_list.name: Purple Scrunchie Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: I…… ran out of gas again and finished 5th, though……

text_block_list.name: Purple Scrunchie Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*……
GaaAAAAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Whoa, hold on! This girl…… she's on a whole 'nother level compared to before, ain't she!?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Kuu……! Come, onnnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Purple Scrunchie Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Guuuuuuu……!
Not yet……not yet, not yet, not yeeeeeeeeeet!!
Surprisingly, it looked like Inari One was being overwhelmed! With 200m left, at this rate……!
The moment I thought that――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: DeeEEEEERyaaAAAAAAA———!
Until the very last moment she was just one step behind, but―― In the end, by a razor-thin nose, Inari One pulled ahead to seize first place……

text_block_list.name: Inari and Others
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*!!

text_block_list.name: Purple Scrunchie Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, daaaaaamnit———!
Lost————!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *wheeze*……N-no, but seriously…… When did ya……get this darn strong……!?

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: That was a close one. But, well――d'ya get it now, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: I don't need ya payin' back no debts. Even without ya――this neighborhood's got youngsters like her who'll hold the fort.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: !? Eh……Chief!! What're ya blabberin' about all of a sudden!? I'm stayin' right here at Chief's side, runnin' in Oi races――

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: What're ya barkin', ya dummy!? ……D'ya think I'm blind? It's plain as day your heart's already elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Ya wanna go to Tracen Academy, don't ya? Stop doin' somethin' pathetic like holdin' yourself back.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Show some Edo pride from downtown! Get out there onto the grand Twinkle Series stage, shake things up, and make some massive waves!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
……!
C……Chief……!!

text_block_list.name: Soba-stand Old Lady
text_block_list.text: That's right! If it's for Inari-chan, I'll go anywhere under the sun to cheer for ya!!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Old Man
text_block_list.text: Our fiery Edo gal, Inari, has stepped up! Go out on that big stage and knock 'em dead!!

text_block_list.name: Townsfolk
text_block_list.text:
WaaAAAAAAA!!
Inari! Inari! Inari! Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone……

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: ……Hmph, what's with that sappy face? Come on, get a move on already!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: You've already found your partner, ain't ya? That race just now……the reason ya found that extra gear at the very end, deep down ya already know why.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Chief……Yeah.
……Yeah, loud and clear!!
And so――several weeks later.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey, hey! Comin' through!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: A downtown working-class gal, straight outta the old streets!! And freshly enrolled at Tracen Academy, the true-blue Edo Kid Inari, that's me!! ……Ya hear me!?
choice_data_list: Inari One……！ I was waiting for you！！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just Inari is plenty fine, keep it casual. Since startin' today, we're ridin' the same long～road together. Right, Boss!?
choice_data_list: Yeah！ We'll take on the world, Inari！
Yeah！ We'll take on the world, Inari！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just Inari is plenty fine, keep it casual. Since startin' today, we're ridin' the same long～road together. Right, Boss!?
choice_data_list: Yeah！ We'll take on the world, Inari！
Yeah！ We'll take on the world, Inari！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm talkin' about!! Alrighty――once again, I came all the way from Oi to set this Twinkle Series on fire!!
